biography.text: Born in 1965 in Daegu, South Korea. Kiel earned B.A. and B.S.E.E. degrees from Rutgers University (1988) and a J.D. from Notre Dame Law School (1991). He clerked for New Jersey Superior Court Judge Michael R. Imbriani and practiced in Princeton, Montvale, and Hackensack before serving as a District of New Jersey magistrate judge from 2019 to 2024. President Joseph R. Biden Jr. nominated him to the district court.
